newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Qingling considers US$100 mln bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Qingling considers US$100 mln bond issue.

text.p: Qingling Motors Co Ltd said on Tuesday it was studying the possibility of issuing a US$100 million principal amount of bonds that could be convertible into H-shares of the company.
The company said in a statement it might grant an over-allotment option to the manager of the proposed bond issue to issue up to a further 15 percent of the principal amount of the convertible bonds.
Terms of the proposed issue, including size of the offering, coupon rate, tenor, redemption price and conversion terms, have not been determined, the statement said.
Proceeds would be used to expand and upgrade existing production facilities, it said.
Application will be made to list the bonds in Hong Kong and in Luxembourg, it said.
